data.description: Observed 2026-07-31: claim_task on t-01KYRVCBE83KT62BAE1502VV29 (open blocking escalation, sole depends_on task done) failed with "task ... is not ready: unmet dependencies". The real blocker was the unanswered escalation; the error names the wrong cause. Either the readiness check lumps escalation-blocks under a dependencies message, or done deps are misread. Reproduce, then make the error name the actual blocker (e.g. "blocked by open escalation <id>").
data.title: claim_task on an escalation-blocked task reports "unmet dependencies"
